title: Azhagesan
desc: Azhagesan, a man with a mental disability, secretly loves his cousin Nandini. However, when Sekhar, an evil man, rapes Nandini and beats Azhagesan, she ends up killing Sekhar and goes to prison.

title: Sri Raja Rajeswari
desc: Raja and Rajeshwari are killed by Ravindranath and his gang. Before dying, Rajeshwari vows that she will return for revenge and with the blessings of a goddess, she is reborn to keep her promise.

title: Maraivaasi
desc: A billionaire's son returns after his father's death and joins the company as a regular employee in order to nab the people responsible for his father's murder.

title: Azhagu Raja
desc: Azhagu Raja, who owns a cable channel, always mocks Priya, who fails at everything. Eventually, love blossoms between them, but their families' bitter past becomes an obstacle to their marriage.

title: Vasanthakala Paravai
desc: Ravi, a shopkeeper, falls in love with Uma, a student, who belongs to a rich family. But their relationship is tested when Uma's brother decides to intervene and break their bond.

title: Thaali Dhaanam
desc: Sridhar marries Kalyani, a kind-hearted woman, and the two live in marital bliss for 12 years. However, their lives take a turn when Kalyani is unable to conceive, leaving her heartbroken.

title: Thayi Pongal
desc: Janaki loses her husband early in her life and is left with a girl child. Without any support, she experiences tough situations involving lecherous men. She meets Vairam who supports her.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Deiva Vaakku
desc: Hamsaveni's divine power earns her respect among the villagers, whereas her brother, Vallatharai, tries to exploit her power for his personal gain. He goes to the extent of sabotaging her marriage.

title: Vaada
desc: Vetrivel decides to exact revenge on the man who destroyed his life. Soon, his wife, an ardent MGR fan, encourages her husband to be inspired from the reel-life hero.
